title: NORM-Nav: Zero-Shot Mobile Robot Navigation with Natural Language Behavioral Constraints
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'socially compliant' robot navigation, which refers to adhering to human behavioral conventions (e.g., keeping to a specific side of a path, adjusting speed near people). While it uses terms like 'socially inappropriate,' these are defined by physical navigation etiquette and constraints, rather than an evaluation of moral, religious, or ethical frameworks.
